gaps.lead: That's the school where my mother teaches.
gaps.explanation: where = in which in formal relative clauses.

gaps.lead: My salary is half the size of my brother's.
gaps.explanation: 'Half the size of' reversed becomes 'twice as much as'.

gaps.lead: 'I have never lied to the press,' the minister said.
gaps.explanation: deny + -ing (ever strengthens the denial): denied ever lying.

gaps.lead: He finally succeeded in solving the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = be able to do.

gaps.lead: No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.

gaps.lead: The journey was so tiring that we slept all day.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ that we slept all day.
gaps.explanation: so tiring (a journey) → such a tiring journey.
